Community Development Block Grant (CDBG) How to apply for a CDBG grant

Eligible South Carolina towns, cities and counties begin the CDBG application process by submitting an application request to SC Commerce. This initial request allows the program team to review the proposed project before the applicant prepares a full application.

Before you apply

Only eligible units of general local government may apply for State CDBG funding.

Before requesting an application, review the current CDBG Application Guidelines for funding categories, eligibility requirements, national objectives and application instructions.

Review the 2026 CDBG Application Guidelines

Request an application

Most Community Development Program funding is awarded competitively through two funding rounds each year. Business Development and Ready to Go Program funding is available on a rolling basis.

Application requests for competitive Community Development funding must be submitted at least 30 days before the application deadline. Requests for Business Development and Ready to Go funding may be submitted at any time.

Community Development application request

Use this form to request an application for:

  • Community Infrastructure
  • Community Enrichment
  • Local Priorities
Download the Community Development application request

Business Development application request

Use this form to request an application for Business Development or Ready to Go Program funding.

Download the Business Development application request

2026 funding deadlines

Spring funding round 

Community Infrastructure

  • Application request deadline: March 20, 2026, by 5 p.m.
  • Application deadline: April 20, 2026, by 5p.m.
  • Application requests: March 20, 2026, by 5 pm
  • Applications: April 20, 2026, by 5 pm

Fall funding round 

Community Enrichment and Local Priorities

  • Application request deadline: August 21, 2026, by 5 p.m.
  • Application deadline: September 21, 2026, by 5 p.m.
  • Applications: September 21, 2026, by 5 pm

Rolling applications

Application requests for Business Development and Ready to Go Program funding may be submitted at any time.

Applicants are encouraged to submit requests before the required 30-day deadline to allow time for project review, clarification and application preparation.

Why is an application request required?

The application request gives SC Commerce basic information about the proposed project and allows the CDBG team to determine whether it appears eligible and consistent with program requirements.

If a project does not appear eligible, the team may help the applicant explore potential adjustments, identify another eligible project or consider other funding resources when appropriate.

What happens next?

After reviewing the request, the CDBG team will contact the applicant with feedback and next steps.

Projects that appear eligible may proceed to the full application process.

Submitting an application request does not guarantee eligibility or funding.
